| description = Dark creatures that roam dungeons, haunted sites and other places with cursed undertones. Their stoned dead eyes are sought after by many adventures, many of whom subestimate the tenacity of such creatures and thus leave their corpses as a warning for whoever is fool enough to go after this risky treasure. Anybody who strikes down any of these creatures is sure to feel the wrath of Mayong Mistmoore, as he is their patron, but at the same time will be looked fondly by the Dragon Rulers of Kunark.
